moves.name: Squat
moves.howTo: Feet about shoulder-width. Sit your hips back like you're sitting on a stool. Knees track over toes. Stand up tall.
moves.mistakes: Knees caving in · rounding the lower back · heels lifting off the floor
moves.easier: Shallower squat, or hold a chair
moves.harder: Go lower, pause at the bottom
moves.cue: Hips back, chest up, stand tall

moves.name: Push-up
moves.howTo: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower chest toward the floor, then press up. Keep the core braced.
moves.mistakes: Hips sagging · flaring elbows wide · shrugging shoulders
moves.easier: Incline push-up on a bench or wall
moves.harder: Feet elevated, or pause at the bottom
moves.cue: Straight line, chest to the floor

moves.name: Incline push-up
moves.howTo: Hands on a sturdy raised surface. Same form as a push-up — straight line from head to heels.
moves.mistakes: Elbows flaring · hips piking up · rushing the reps
moves.harder: Lower the surface toward the floor
moves.cue: Hands on the desk, body straight

moves.name: Reverse lunge
moves.howTo: Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend about 90°. Front heel stays planted. Drive up through the front leg.
moves.mistakes: Front knee caving in · torso tipping forward · tiny steps
moves.easier: Shallower depth, or hold a chair
moves.harder: Pause at the bottom, or reverse lunges with a pulse

moves.name: Split squat
moves.howTo: Stagger your stance and drop the back knee toward the floor. Keep most weight on the front leg. Switch sides as programmed.
moves.mistakes: Leaning too far forward · front heel lifting · rushing
moves.easier: Hold a chair, or shorten the range
moves.harder: Longer stance, or rear foot elevated
moves.cue: Drop the back knee, front heel down

moves.name: Glute bridge
moves.howTo: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Squeeze glutes and lift hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up. Lower with control.
moves.mistakes: Arching the lower back · pushing through toes · not squeezing at the top
moves.harder: Single-leg bridge, or pause at the top

moves.name: Plank
moves.howTo: Forearms or hands under shoulders. Body in a straight line. Brace your core and breathe steadily.
moves.mistakes: Hips sagging · bum too high · holding your breath
moves.harder: Lift one foot, or shoulder taps

moves.name: Side plank
moves.howTo: On one forearm (or hand), stack feet or stagger them. Lift hips so the body is a straight line. Switch sides as programmed.
moves.mistakes: Hips dropping · rolling forward · shrugging the supporting shoulder
moves.easier: Bent bottom knee on the floor
moves.harder: Top leg raised, or short hip dips
moves.cue: Hips up, body in a line

moves.name: Superman
moves.howTo: Lie face-down. Lift arms and legs off the floor at the same time, squeeze the upper back and glutes, then lower softly.
moves.mistakes: Yank the neck up · slamming limbs down · holding breath
moves.easier: Lift only arms, or only legs
moves.harder: Hold the top for a few breaths
moves.cue: Lift arms and legs, then lower

moves.name: Dead bug
moves.howTo: On your back, arms up, knees over hips. Slowly extend opposite arm and leg toward the floor without arching your back. Switch sides.
moves.mistakes: Lower back peeling off the floor · rushing · shoulders shrugging
moves.easier: Move only the arms, or only the legs
moves.harder: Slow the tempo, hover closer to the floor
moves.cue: Back flat, reach opposite arm and leg

moves.name: Shoulder tap
moves.howTo: High plank. Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without rocking the hips. Alternate sides.
moves.mistakes: Wide hip sway · feet too narrow · collapsing through the shoulders

moves.name: Wall sit
moves.howTo: Back flat against a wall, slide down until thighs are about parallel to the floor. Knees over ankles. Hold and breathe.
moves.mistakes: Knees past toes · rounding the back · holding your breath
moves.cue: Back to the wall, thighs level

moves.name: Bird dog
moves.howTo: On all fours. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back. Keep hips level. Return and switch.
moves.mistakes: Arching the back · twisting the hips · looking up hard
moves.easier: Move only the arm, or only the leg
moves.harder: Hold the reach, or add a crunch-in
moves.cue: Reach opposite arm and leg, hips level

moves.name: March on the spot
moves.howTo: Stand tall and march gently, lifting knees a comfortable height. Swing the arms softly. Keep it quiet and easy.
moves.cue: Knees up, arms swing, keep it quiet

moves.name: Good morning
moves.howTo: Soft knees, hinge at the hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand tall. Hands can rest on hips or behind the head.
moves.mistakes: Rounding the spine · locking the knees · bending only at the waist
moves.harder: Slower tempo, pause at the bottom
moves.cue: Hinge at the hips, flat back

moves.name: Arm circles
moves.howTo: Arms out to the sides. Draw slow circles forward, then reverse. Keep shoulders relaxed. (Warm-up step — no animation needed.)
moves.mistakes: Shrugging · spinning too fast · locking the elbows hard
